findings.location: source.html paragraph containing: "I ordered a copy of The Martyr’s Mirror"
findings.source_quote: I ordered a copy of The Martyr’s Mirror and was astounded when I read about these people who lived like the disciples.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the book title into Dutch (or provide the conventional Dutch title) and preserve the surrounding HTML and emphasis. Example: vervang The Martyr’s Mirror door De Martelspiegels (of de gebruikelijke Nederlandse editionele titel), keeping the tag unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: Ik bestelde een exemplaar van The Martyr’s Mirror en was verbaasd toen ik las over deze mensen die leefden als de discipelen.

findings.source_quote: When I was converted, I had never heard the term Anabaptist.
findings.suggested_fix: Capitalize the translator's rendering of the group name consistently to match the source's proper-name usage. Change "anabaptist" to "Anabaptist" (or "Anabaptisten" depending on house style) in the first instance to match later usages and treat it as a proper noun.
findings.translation_quote: Toen ik bekeerd werd, had ik de term anabaptist nog nooit gehoord.
